experience.headline: A software and QA foundation for reliable operations.

Builds reporting used by Membership, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Operations, identifying risks before inaccurate data reaches communications or decisions.

Developed SQL and Python tools, ETL workflows, automation, data-transfer processes, and user-facing applications supporting internal operational workflows. Built repeatable data processes that reduced manual work and improved maintainability.

roles.text: Advanced from volunteer contributor to paid QA and live-operations support. Performed regression and pre-release testing, reproduced defects, investigated unexpected system behavior, validated fixes, and documented actionable findings for developers. This work established the troubleshooting mindset I now apply to data and operational analysis.

Tested game systems, reproduced technical issues, validated data consistency, and documented defects with clear reproduction steps. Earned additional responsibility through dependable testing, communication, and follow-through.

selectedWork.headline: Investigations that improve how systems work.
selectedWork.intro: Selected examples of CRM data integrity, process investigation, reconciliation, and operational monitoring.

items.title: Membership Flowdown Integrity
items.summary: Investigated recurring membership-flowdown discrepancies across Salesforce/Nimble and built repeatable tracking for new failures.
items.challenge: Membership relationships repeatedly failed to flow down as expected, creating CRM data-integrity concerns.
items.investigation: Used SQL/SOQL and record-level comparisons to isolate affected patterns, monitor failures over time, and investigate potential automated remediation. Some failures traced to underlying membership configuration.
items.solution: Created a repeatable tracking and monitoring process for newly occurring failures and documented verified findings for root-cause correction.
items.impact: Helped shift the response from isolated tickets toward configuration correction and recurrence prevention.
evidence: Tracking of newly occurring failures over time

items.title: Payment Reminder Process & Data Quality
items.summary: Reverse-engineered the audience-building process and helped prevent inaccurate payment communications before deployment.
items.challenge: The audience depended on manually combined reports and spreadsheet lookups, with different invoice categories requiring different handling.
items.investigation: Traced reporting and filtering limitations, clarified business rules with Finance, Sales/Operations, and related stakeholders, and identified questionable recipient and payment data.
items.solution: Helped pause and rebuild the audience, validate checkout/payment links, and refresh data near deployment to account for recent payments.
items.impact: The campaign was paused and rebuilt before inaccurate communications were sent, reducing the risk of stale reminders reaching recently paid customers.

items.title: Council Assignment & CRM Reconciliation
items.summary: Designed matching and reconciliation logic while migrating and correcting CRM council relationships.
items.challenge: Historical affiliations, merged-record exceptions, and inconsistent relationships complicated accurate record matching.
items.investigation: Compared records across systems, developed unique lookup keys, and worked through historical affiliation conflicts and merged-record exceptions.
items.solution: Created repeatable matching and reconciliation logic, tested imports iteratively, and resolved import errors with verified examples.
items.impact: Reconciled and imported council-affiliation records through a repeatable process that supported migration quality and relationship accuracy.
evidence: Unique lookup keys and matching methodology
Iterative import testing and exception resolution

items.title: Operational Audit & Monitoring Framework
items.summary: Designed reusable SQL-based audits with severity thresholds and historical logging to make operational risks consistently reviewable.
items.challenge: Recurring workflows needed a consistent way to surface data-quality issues, automation failures, and contactability risks.
items.investigation: Defined reusable checks against source data and process health, with severity classification and historical findings for review.
items.solution: Built reusable SQL validation and audit logging to reduce manual review and provide a foundation for proactive alerting and dashboarding.
items.impact: A company-level reachability audit surfaced organizations without an assigned primary contact, turning a data gap into a reviewable finding.
